packages.name: Now Playing
packages.description: Shows the song playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, any app that shows up in Windows' media controls): title, artist, time, a progress bar and an audio spectrum.
packages.author: Yuniverse

firmware.name: REVIVER v22
firmware.notes: Fixes screens you turned on (like the clock) not showing up when you press the screen button: v21 only loaded your screen list when the boot animation ran. Everything from v21: your own screen list (Screens tab), a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
